## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check-types`, `bunx biome ci .`, `bun run test` and `bun run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] User-facing changes have an end-to-end test
- [ ] A line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`, if users or self-hosters would notice
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` updated, if this changes how something works
- [ ] Changes to what the server can see are reflected in `docs/security.md`
